relationships.subject: Conus textile venom subfractions
relationships.evidence_quote: Intrathecal injection of C. Tex and C. Mil subfractions reduced flinching/licking behavior during the second phase of formalin test and attenuated thermal and mechanical allodynia in nerve injury model.

relationships.subject: Conus textile venom subfractions
relationships.evidence_quote: Treatment with proteolytic enzymes reduced CB1 internalization of subfractions, indicating the peptidergic nature of CB1 active component.

key_findings: Conus venom subfractions induce CB1 internalization and reduce pain behaviors in rats with mild CB tetrad side effects.
